auditor_kim: Quick ask — please provide a compact, fully reproducible export I can run for three cases: (1) RBAC change, (2) KMS key rotation, (3) vuln -> incident. I need the exact CLI/UI steps, canonical object keys (S3/GCS), checksum+signature procedure, retention/immutability notes, and which SOC2/ISO controls each artifact maps to.

export-bot: I can pre-create prefixes under s3://audit-exports/ if owners confirm.

julia.sun: I'll own RBAC sample. Minimal steps (AWS + GKE):
`terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform show -json tfplan > /tmp/tfplan.json`
`aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name "/aws/cloudtrail/Redwood" --filter-pattern "AttachRolePolicy|PutRolePolicy|UpdateAssumeRolePolicy" --start-time 1712000000000 --end-time 1712000360000 > /tmp/iam_events.json`
`kubectl get rolebinding,clusterrolebinding -o yaml --all-namespaces > /tmp/rolebindings.yaml`
Upload path: `s3://audit-exports/rbac/{ticket}/{ts}/tfplan.json, iam_events.json, rolebindings.yaml, approvals.pdf, manifest.txt, manifest.txt.asc`
Manifest/sign steps: `sha256sum * > manifest.txt` then `gpg --local-user julia@redwood --armor --detach-sign manifest.txt`
Control mapping: SOC2 CC6.1, ISO 27001 A.9.2.3 (proof of change, approver).

omar_reza: I'll take KMS rotation (AWS example). Commands: 
`aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/prod-cmk > /tmp/key_meta.json`
`aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/prod-cmk --policy-name default > /tmp/key_policy.json`
`aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name "/aws/cloudtrail/Redwood" --filter-pattern "RotateKey|DisableKey|CreateGrant|RevokeGrant" --start-time 1712000000000 --end-time 1712000360000 > /tmp/kms_events.json`
Envelope evidence: `aws s3api head-object --bucket prod-backups --key backups/enc-2024-12-01.tar.gz > /tmp/object_meta.json`
Upload path: `s3://audit-exports/kms/{key_alias}/{ts}/key_meta.json,key_policy.json,kms_events.json,object_meta.json,manifest.txt,manifest.txt.asc`
Bundle encryption: encrypt final bundle with CMK and record key_arn in manifest. Control mapping: SOC2 CC6.2, ISO A.10.1 (key lifecycle).

samir.patel: Incident flow (vuln -> incident) — minimal reproducible set: ticket export, PR(s), CI artifact SHA, deploy trace, alert snapshot, redacted chat. Commands: 
`curl -u $JIRA_API_TOKEN "https://redwood.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/issue/$TICKET" > /tmp/ticket.json`
`sha256sum build/artifact.tar.gz > /tmp/artifact.sha256`
`curl -s "https://deploy.internal/api/v1/traces?deploy_id=$DEPLOY_ID" > /tmp/deploy_trace.json`
`curl -g "https://prometheus.internal/api/v1/query_range?query=ALERTS&start=1712000000&end=1712000360" > /tmp/alerts.json`
`/compliance/export_slack --channel incident-bridge --start 1712000000 --end 1712000360 > /tmp/slack_raw.txt` then `python3 /tools/redact_slack.py /tmp/slack_raw.txt /tmp/slack_redacted.txt`
Upload path: `s3://audit-exports/incidents/{ticket}/{ts}/ticket.json,artifact.sha256,deploy_trace.json,alerts.json,slack_redacted.txt,manifest.txt,manifest.txt.asc`
Control mapping: SOC2 CC7.1, ISO A.16.1.3 (incident evidence).

auditor_kim: How do you show chain-of-custody and immutability? I need exact verification steps.

julia.sun: Chain-of-custody: uploader runs `sha256sum` to produce `manifest.txt` (format: `<sha256>  <filename>` per line), then GPG-signs manifest. CI job that uploads adds S3 object metadata: `uploader=<user>`, `ci_job=<id>`, `upload_time=<iso>`. Finalized bundles: set S3 Object Lock (GOVERNANCE) and copy sealed archive to Glacier Deep for 7 years. Raw PII-containing artifacts are quarantined; only redacted exports are in audit buckets.

omar_reza: Verification steps we provide: download manifest + signature, verify checksums and signature: 
`aws s3 cp s3://.../manifest.txt ./`
`aws s3 cp s3://.../manifest.txt.asc ./`
`sha256sum -c manifest.txt`
`gpg --verify manifest.txt.asc manifest.txt`
We will also publish the public GPG keys at `https://keys.redwood.internal/audit-keys.pub` and include the key fingerprint in the manifest.

auditor_kim: OK. Please attach one RBAC sample bundle and one KMS sample bundle to AUD-2026-999 with exact S3 keys and the manifest.asc so I can run the verification during the scheduled window.

export-bot: Created task AUD-2026-999 and scheduled verification 2026-04-22T16:00Z. Owners: @julia.sun (RBAC), @omar_reza (KMS), @samir.patel (incident).

auditor_kim: Thanks — ping me once uploads are complete.
